   368	    // Price oracle (keeper / DVT / break-glass)
   369	    // ====================================
   370	
   371	    /// @notice True when Chainlink hasn't updated for at least CHAINLINK_STALE_THRESHOLD, or reverts.
   372	    function _isChainlinkStale() internal view returns (bool) {
   373	        try ETH_USD_PRICE_FEED.latestRoundData() returns (uint80, int256, uint256, uint256 chainlinkUpdatedAt, uint80) {
   374	            if (chainlinkUpdatedAt == 0) return true;
   375	            return block.timestamp > chainlinkUpdatedAt + CHAINLINK_STALE_THRESHOLD;
   376	        } catch {
   377	            return true;
   378	        }
   379	    }
   380	
   381	    function isChainlinkStale() external view returns (bool) {
   382	        return _isChainlinkStale();
   383	    }
   384	
   385	    /// @notice Returns the timestamp after which the cached price is considered stale (0 if never set).
   386	    function priceValidUntil() external view returns (uint48) {
   387	        if (cachedPrice.updatedAt == 0) return 0;
   388	        return uint48(cachedPrice.updatedAt + priceStalenessThreshold);
   389	    }
   390	
   391	    function _checkEmergencyPrice(int256 newPrice) private view {
   392	        if (newPrice <= 0) revert OracleError();
   393	        if (!_isChainlinkStale()) revert ChainlinkNotStale();
   394	        if (emergencyActivatedAt != 0 && block.timestamp > emergencyActivatedAt + EMERGENCY_EXPIRY) {
   395	            revert EmergencyExpired();
   396	        }
   397	
   398	        int256 ref = cachedPrice.price;
   399	        if (ref <= 0) revert OracleError();
   400	
   401	        int256 denominator = int256(uint256(BPS_DENOMINATOR));
   402	        int256 lower = (ref
   403	                * int256(int256(uint256(BPS_DENOMINATOR - EMERGENCY_PRICE_DEVIATION_BPS)))
   404	                + denominator
   405	                - 1) / denominator;
   406	        int256 upper = (ref * int256(int256(uint256(BPS_DENOMINATOR + EMERGENCY_PRICE_DEVIATION_BPS)))) / denominator;
   407	        if (newPrice < lower || newPrice > upper) revert EmergencyPriceOutOfRange();
   408	    }
   409	
   410	    /// @notice Queue an emergency price update. Only honored when Chainlink is stale and the new
   411	    ///         price stays within ±20% of the last cached price; executable after EMERGENCY_TIMELOCK.
   412	    function emergencySetPrice(int256 newPrice) external onlyOwner {
   413	        _checkEmergencyPrice(newPrice);
   414	
   415	        emergencyPendingPrice = newPrice;
   416	        emergencyQueuedAt = block.timestamp;
   417	        emit EmergencyPriceQueued(newPrice, block.timestamp + EMERGENCY_TIMELOCK);
   418	    }
   419	
   420	    /// @notice Cancel a queued emergency price.
   421	    function cancelEmergencyPrice() external onlyOwner {
   422	        if (emergencyQueuedAt == 0) return; // idempotent
   423	        int256 cancelled = emergencyPendingPrice;
   424	        emergencyQueuedAt = 0;
   425	        emergencyPendingPrice = 0;
   426	        emit EmergencyPriceCancelled(cancelled);
   427	    }
   428	
   429	    /// @notice Apply a previously queued emergency price. Permissionless after the timelock, but
   430	    ///         the stale-oracle, expiry and deviation gates are re-checked against execution-time state.
   431	    function executeEmergencyPrice() external {
   432	        if (emergencyQueuedAt == 0) revert NoEmergencyPending();
   433	        if (block.timestamp < emergencyQueuedAt + EMERGENCY_TIMELOCK) {
   434	            revert EmergencyTimelockNotElapsed();
   435	        }
   436	
   437	        int256 newPrice = emergencyPendingPrice;
   438	        _checkEmergencyPrice(newPrice);
   439	        cachedPrice.price = newPrice;
   440	        cachedPrice.updatedAt = block.timestamp;
   441	        cachedPrice.roundId = 0;
   442	        cachedPrice.decimals = 8;
   443	
   444	        if (priceMode != 1) {
   445	            emit PriceModeChanged(priceMode, 1, msg.sender);
   446	            priceMode = 1;
   447	            emergencyActivatedAt = block.timestamp;
   448	        }
   449	
   450	        emergencyQueuedAt = 0;
   451	        emergencyPendingPrice = 0;
   452	
   453	        emit EmergencyPriceExecuted(newPrice);
   454	        emit PriceUpdated(newPrice, block.timestamp, msg.sender);
   455	    }
   456	
   457	    /**
   458	     * @notice Update price via DVT/BLS consensus or the owner (Safe) break-glass path.
   459	     * @dev The BLS aggregator is capped per update to ±20% of the cached price. The owner is
   460	     *      uncapped within [MIN_ETH_USD_PRICE, MAX_ETH_USD_PRICE]. Both callers remain subject to
   461	     *      two-hour recency, future-timestamp grace, strictly increasing updatedAt, and the
   462	     *      Chainlink ±20% check when Chainlink is fresh.
   463	     * @param chainlinkRecovered 0 = Chainlink still unavailable; 1 = recovered (clears priceMode).
   464	     */
   465	    function updatePriceDVT(int256 price, uint256 updatedAt, bytes calldata proof, uint8 chainlinkRecovered) external {
   466	        proof; // verified by BLSAggregator before it calls this function
   467	        // 1. Verify caller authority (owner path = emergency break-glass; Chainlink ±20% guard below)
   468	        if (msg.sender != BLS_AGGREGATOR && msg.sender != owner()) revert Unauthorized();
   469	
   470	        // V3.6 FIX: Prevent Replay & Staleness
   471	        if (updatedAt <= cachedPrice.updatedAt) revert OracleError(); // Must be strictly increasing
   472	        if (updatedAt < block.timestamp - 2 hours) revert OracleError(); // Must be recent
   473	        // P0-16: reject future timestamps (15 s keeper clock-skew grace).
   474	        if (updatedAt > block.timestamp + TIMESTAMP_GRACE_SECONDS) revert OracleError();
   475	
   476	        // 3. Validate absolute bounds and the per-update BLS movement cap.
   477	        if (price < MIN_ETH_USD_PRICE || price > MAX_ETH_USD_PRICE) revert OracleError();
   478	        if (msg.sender == BLS_AGGREGATOR && msg.sender != owner()) {
   479	            int256 referencePrice = cachedPrice.price;
   480	            if (referencePrice > 0) {
   481	                int256 delta = price > referencePrice ? price - referencePrice : referencePrice - price;
   482	                if (delta * int256(BPS_DENOMINATOR) > referencePrice * int256(EMERGENCY_PRICE_DEVIATION_BPS)) {
   483	                    revert OracleError();
   484	                }
   485	            }
   486	        }
   487	
   488	        // 4. Deviation from Chainlink (±20%) when Chainlink is recent
   489	        try ETH_USD_PRICE_FEED.latestRoundData() returns (
   490	            uint80, int256 chainlinkPrice, uint256, uint256 chainlinkUpdatedAt, uint80
   491	        ) {
   492	            // P1-42: guard chainlinkPrice <= 0 to prevent div-by-zero
   493	            if (chainlinkPrice > 0 && block.timestamp - chainlinkUpdatedAt < 2 hours) {
   494	                int256 delta = price > chainlinkPrice ? price - chainlinkPrice : chainlinkPrice - price;
   495	                if (delta * int256(BPS_DENOMINATOR) > chainlinkPrice * int256(EMERGENCY_PRICE_DEVIATION_BPS)) {
   496	                    revert OracleError();
   497	                }
   498	            }
   499	        } catch {
   500	            // Chainlink down: DVT price accepted without deviation check
   501	        }
   502	
   503	        // 5. Update cache
   504	        cachedPrice = PriceCache({
   505	            price: price,
   506	            updatedAt: updatedAt,
   507	            roundId: 0, // DVT doesn't have Chainlink RoundID
   508	            decimals: 8 // DVT normalizes to 8 decimals
   509	        });
   510	
   511	        if (chainlinkRecovered == 1 && priceMode != 0) {
   512	            emit PriceModeChanged(priceMode, 0, msg.sender);
   513	            priceMode = 0;
   514	            emergencyActivatedAt = 0;
   515	        }
   516	
   517	        emit PriceUpdated(price, updatedAt, msg.sender);
   518	    }
   519	
   520	    /// @notice Update price cache from Chainlink oracle (keeper-callable).
   521	    function updatePrice() external {
   522	        try ETH_USD_PRICE_FEED.latestRoundData() returns (
   523	            uint80 roundId, int256 price, uint256, uint256 updatedAt, uint80 answeredInRound
   524	        ) {
   525	            if (price < MIN_ETH_USD_PRICE || price > MAX_ETH_USD_PRICE) revert OracleError();
   526	            if (updatedAt < block.timestamp - priceStalenessThreshold) revert OracleError();
   527	            if (answeredInRound < roundId) revert OracleError();
   528	
   529	            cachedPrice = PriceCache({price: price, updatedAt: updatedAt, roundId: roundId, decimals: 8});
   530	
   531	            // P0-10: Chainlink came back — leave EMERGENCY mode and drop any queued override.
   532	            if (priceMode != 0) {
   533	                emit PriceModeChanged(priceMode, 0, msg.sender);
   534	                priceMode = 0;
   535	                emergencyActivatedAt = 0;
   536	            }
   537	            if (emergencyQueuedAt != 0) {
   538	                int256 cancelled = emergencyPendingPrice;
   539	                emergencyQueuedAt = 0;
   540	                emergencyPendingPrice = 0;
   541	                emit EmergencyPriceCancelled(cancelled);
   542	            }
   543	
   544	            emit PriceUpdated(price, updatedAt, msg.sender);
   545	        } catch {
   546	            // Chainlink down: keeper should call updatePriceDVT() with BLS proof, or the owner can
   547	            // use emergencySetPrice + executeEmergencyPrice.
   548	            revert OracleError();
   549	        }
   550	    }

   556	    /// @notice Remaining credit headroom for `user` on `token` (saturating; spec §10.4 / R4-H4).
   557	    function getAvailableCredit(address user, address token) external view returns (uint256) {
   558	        IxPNTsTokenV2 t = IxPNTsTokenV2(token);
   559	        uint256 cap = t.effectiveCreditCap(user);
   560	        uint256 used = t.debts(user) + t.creditReservedOf(user);
   561	        return cap > used ? cap - used : 0;
   562	    }

   564	    // ====================================
   565	    // Reputation & Slash Management
   566	    // ====================================
   567	
   568	    /**
   569	     * @notice Mark an operator as having a pending slash (owner, BLS aggregator, or guardian).
   570	     * @dev M-5: an owner or BLS queue blocks requestWithdraw/withdraw until the slash executes or is
   571	     *      cancelled. An unconfirmed guardian queue blocks only until queuedAt + GUARDIAN_SLASH_FREEZE
   572	     *      (7 days) and then expires (isSlashPending() turns false); owner/BLS confirmation makes it
   573	     *      persistent. Guardian repeats revert while unresolved. Owner repeats overwrite provenance and
   574	     *      time; BLS repeats do the same outside its cooldown.
   575	     */
   576	    function queueSlash(address operator) external {
   577	        address actor = msg.sender;
   578	        bool byGuardian = actor == guardian && actor != address(0) && actor != owner() && actor != BLS_AGGREGATOR;
   579	        if (actor != owner() && actor != BLS_AGGREGATOR && !byGuardian) revert Unauthorized();
   580	        if (byGuardian) {
   581	            if (slashQueues[operator].guardianQueued) revert GuardianSlashUnresolved();
   582	            if (_isSlashPending(operator)) revert SlashPending();
   583	        } else if (actor == BLS_AGGREGATOR && actor != owner() && uint48(block.timestamp) < _blsCooldownEnd(operator)) {
   584	            revert SlashCooldown();
   585	        }
   586	        _pendingSlash[operator] = true;
   587	        slashQueues[operator] = SlashQueue(actor, uint48(block.timestamp), byGuardian);
   588	        emit SlashQueued(operator, msg.sender);
   589	    }
   590	
   591	    /// @dev Effective end of the BLS-slash cooldown: max(per-operator cooldown, global floor).
   592	    function _blsCooldownEnd(address operator) internal view returns (uint48) {
   593	        uint48 cd = _blsSlashCd[operator];
   594	        uint48 fl = _blsSlashCdFloor;
   595	        return fl > cd ? fl : cd;
   596	    }
   597	
   598	    /// @notice One-shot prime of the global BLS-slash cooldown floor to `now + SLASH_BLS_COOLDOWN`.
   599	    function primeBlsSlashCooldown() external onlyOwner {
   600	        _blsSlashCdFloor = uint48(block.timestamp) + SLASH_BLS_COOLDOWN;
   601	        emit BlsSlashCooldownPrimed(_blsSlashCdFloor);
   602	    }
   603	
   604	    /// @notice Cancel a previously queued slash (owner only). Idempotent; emits only when a flag or
   605	    ///         a queue record (including an expired guardian queue) was actually cleared.
   606	    function cancelSlash(address operator) external onlyOwner {
   607	        if (!_pendingSlash[operator] && slashQueues[operator].queuedAt == 0) return;
   608	        _clearSlashQueue(operator);
   609	        emit SlashCancelled(operator, msg.sender);
   610	    }
   611	
   612	    /// @notice Whether `operator` currently has an effective withdrawal-blocking slash status.
   613	    function isSlashPending(address operator) external view returns (bool) {
   614	        return _isSlashPending(operator);
   615	    }
   616	
   617	    /**
   618	     * @notice Slash an operator (Admin/Governance only). Requires queueSlash first; 24h cooldown.
   619	     */
   620	    function slashOperator(
   621	        address operator,
   622	        ISuperPaymaster.SlashLevel level,
   623	        uint256 penaltyAmount,
   624	        string calldata reason
   625	    ) external onlyOwner {
   626	        _slashOperator(operator, level, penaltyAmount, reason);
   627	    }
   628	
   629	    /// @notice Atomically release supplied stale reservations and slash their operator.
   630	    function slashOperatorAfterReleasing(
   631	        address operator,
   632	        ISuperPaymaster.SlashLevel level,
   633	        uint256 penaltyAmount,
   634	        string calldata reason,
   635	        bytes32[] calldata staleOpHashes
   636	    ) external onlyOwner {
   637	        _releaseSuppliedStale(operator, staleOpHashes);
   638	        _slashOperator(operator, level, penaltyAmount, reason);
   639	    }
   640	
   641	    function _slashOperator(
   642	        address operator,
   643	        ISuperPaymaster.SlashLevel level,
   644	        uint256 penaltyAmount,
   645	        string memory reason
   646	    ) internal {
   647	        require(_isSlashPending(operator), "SP: must queueSlash first");
   648	        if (uint48(block.timestamp) < _slashCd[operator]) revert SlashCooldown();
   649	        _slashCd[operator] = uint48(block.timestamp) + 24 hours;
   650	        _slash(operator, level, penaltyAmount, reason, true);
   651	        _clearSlashQueue(operator);
   652	    }
   653	
   654	    /// @notice Update Operator Reputation (External Credit Manager)
   655	    function updateReputation(address operator, uint256 newScore) external onlyOwner {
   656	        if (newScore > type(uint32).max) revert ScoreExceedsUint32();
   657	        operators[operator].reputation = uint32(newScore);
   658	        emit ISuperPaymaster.ReputationUpdated(operator, newScore, msg.sender);
   659	    }
   660	
   661	    /**
   662	     * @notice Execute slash triggered by BLS consensus (DVT Module only)
   663	     */
   664	    function executeSlashWithBLS(address operator, ISuperPaymaster.SlashLevel level, bytes calldata proof) external {
   665	        if (msg.sender != BLS_AGGREGATOR) revert Unauthorized();
   666	        _executeSlashWithBLS(operator, level, proof);
   667	    }
   668	
   669	    function _executeSlashWithBLS(address operator, ISuperPaymaster.SlashLevel level, bytes memory proof) internal {
   670	        require(_isSlashPending(operator), "SP: must queueSlash first");
   671	        if (uint48(block.timestamp) < _blsCooldownEnd(operator)) revert SlashCooldown();
   672	        uint256 reserved = inflightReserved[operator];
   673	        if (reserved != 0) revert SlashBlockedByInflight(reserved);
   674	        _blsSlashCd[operator] = uint48(block.timestamp) + SLASH_BLS_COOLDOWN;
   675	
   676	        uint256 collateral = uint256(operators[operator].aPNTsBalance) + pendingWithdrawals[operator].amount;
   677	        // Logical penalty before cap: Warning=0, Minor=10%, Major=full collateral (capped at 30% in _slash).
   678	        uint256 penalty = 0;
   679	        if (level == ISuperPaymaster.SlashLevel.MINOR) {
   680	            penalty = collateral / 10;
   681	        } else if (level == ISuperPaymaster.SlashLevel.MAJOR) {
   682	            penalty = collateral;
   683	        }
   684	
   685	        bytes32 proofHash = keccak256(proof);
   686	
   687	        penalty = _slash(operator, level, penalty, "DVT BLS Slash", true);
   688	        _clearSlashQueue(operator);
   689	
   690	        emit SlashExecutedWithProof(operator, level, penalty, proofHash, block.timestamp);
   691	    }
   692	
   693	    function _releaseSuppliedStale(address operator, bytes32[] calldata staleOpHashes) internal {
   694	        for (uint256 i; i < staleOpHashes.length; ++i) {
   695	            Inflight memory f = _inflight[staleOpHashes[i]];
   696	            if (f.operator != address(0) && f.operator != operator) revert Unauthorized();
   697	            _releaseStaleSponsorship(staleOpHashes[i]);
   698	        }
   699	    }
   700	
   701	    /// @param applyCap If true, enforce 30% slash hardcap.
   702	    function _slash(
   703	        address operator,
   704	        ISuperPaymaster.SlashLevel level,
   705	        uint256 penaltyAmount,
   706	        string memory reason,
   707	        bool applyCap
   708	    ) internal returns (uint256) {
   709	        uint256 reserved = inflightReserved[operator];
   710	        if (reserved != 0) revert SlashBlockedByInflight(reserved);
   711	        ISuperPaymaster.OperatorConfig storage config = operators[operator];
   712	
   713	        uint256 reputationLoss =
   714	            level == ISuperPaymaster.SlashLevel.WARNING ? 10 : (level == ISuperPaymaster.SlashLevel.MINOR ? 20 : 50);
   715	        // Attribute a pause to the slash only on an actual unpaused -> paused transition, so a
   716	        // slash of an operator already paused by owner/guardian does not re-attribute that pause.
   717	        if (level == ISuperPaymaster.SlashLevel.MAJOR && !config.isPaused) {
   718	            config.isPaused = true;
   719	            emit OperatorPaused(operator, msg.sender, SLASH);
   720	        }
   721	
   722	        if (config.reputation > reputationLoss) config.reputation -= uint32(reputationLoss);
   723	        else config.reputation = 0;
   724	
   725	        if (penaltyAmount > 0) {
   726	            PendingWithdrawal storage pending = pendingWithdrawals[operator];
   727	            uint256 collateral = uint256(config.aPNTsBalance) + pending.amount;
   728	            if (applyCap) {
   729	                // V3.6 SECURITY: Enforce 30% Slash Hardcap
   730	                // No in-flight reservation exists; total collateral is liquid balance plus withdrawal escrow.
   731	                uint256 maxSlash = (collateral * 3000) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;
   732	                if (penaltyAmount > maxSlash) {
   733	                    penaltyAmount = maxSlash;
   734	                    reason = string(abi.encodePacked(reason, " (Capped at 30%)"));
   735	                }
   736	            }
   737	
   738	            if (penaltyAmount > collateral) penaltyAmount = collateral;
   739	            uint256 fromBalance = penaltyAmount > config.aPNTsBalance ? config.aPNTsBalance : penaltyAmount;
   740	            if (fromBalance != 0) config.aPNTsBalance -= uint128(fromBalance);
   741	            uint256 fromEscrow = penaltyAmount - fromBalance;
   742	            if (fromEscrow != 0) {
   743	                pending.amount -= uint128(fromEscrow);
   744	                if (pending.amount == 0) delete pendingWithdrawals[operator];
   745	            }
   746	            protocolRevenue += penaltyAmount;
   747	        }
   748	
   749	        slashHistory[operator].push(
   750	            ISuperPaymaster.SlashRecord({
   751	                timestamp: block.timestamp,
   752	                amount: penaltyAmount,
   753	                reputationLoss: reputationLoss,
   754	                reason: reason,
   755	                level: level
   756	            })
   757	        );
   758	
   759	        emit ISuperPaymaster.OperatorSlashed(operator, penaltyAmount, level, msg.sender);
   760	        emit ISuperPaymaster.ReputationUpdated(operator, config.reputation, msg.sender);
   761	        return penaltyAmount;
   762	    }
   763	
   764	    // P0-3 (initial-deploy path): one-time setter when BLS_AGGREGATOR == address(0).
   765	    function initBLSAggregator(address _bls) external onlyOwner {
   766	        if (BLS_AGGREGATOR != address(0)) revert InvalidConfiguration(); // already initialized — use queue/apply
   767	        if (_bls == address(0)) revert InvalidAddress();
   768	        BLS_AGGREGATOR = _bls;
   769	        emit BLSAggregatorUpdated(address(0), _bls);
   770	    }
   771	
   772	    // P0-3: 24h timelock on BLSAggregator replacement.
   773	    function queueBLSAggregator(address _bls) external onlyOwner {
   774	        if (_bls == address(0)) revert InvalidAddress();
   775	        pendingBLSAgg = _bls;
   776	        pendingBLSAggEta = uint48(block.timestamp + 24 hours);
   777	        emit BLSAggregatorQueued(_bls, pendingBLSAggEta);
   778	    }
   779	
   780	    function applyBLSAggregator() external onlyOwner {
   781	        address p = pendingBLSAgg;
   782	        if (p == address(0)) revert InvalidConfiguration();
   783	        if (uint48(block.timestamp) < pendingBLSAggEta) revert InvalidConfiguration();
   784	        address old = BLS_AGGREGATOR;
   785	        BLS_AGGREGATOR = p;
   786	        pendingBLSAgg = address(0);
   787	        pendingBLSAggEta = 0;
   788	        emit BLSAggregatorUpdated(old, p);
   789	    }
   790	
   791	    // ====================================
   792	    // Slash Query Interfaces
   793	    // ====================================
   794	
   795	    function getSlashHistory(address operator) external view returns (ISuperPaymaster.SlashRecord[] memory) {
   796	        return slashHistory[operator];
   797	    }
   798	
   799	    function getSlashCount(address operator) external view returns (uint256) {
   800	        return slashHistory[operator].length;
   801	    }
   802	
   803	    function getLatestSlash(address operator) external view returns (ISuperPaymaster.SlashRecord memory) {
   804	        if (slashHistory[operator].length == 0) revert NoSlashHistory();
   805	        return slashHistory[operator][slashHistory[operator].length - 1];
   806	    }

   371	    /// @notice True when Chainlink hasn't updated for at least CHAINLINK_STALE_THRESHOLD, or reverts.
   372	    function _isChainlinkStale() internal view returns (bool) {
   373	        try ETH_USD_PRICE_FEED.latestRoundData() returns (uint80, int256, uint256, uint256 chainlinkUpdatedAt, uint80) {
   374	            if (chainlinkUpdatedAt == 0) return true;
   375	            return block.timestamp > chainlinkUpdatedAt + CHAINLINK_STALE_THRESHOLD;
   376	        } catch {
   377	            return true;
   378	        }
   379	    }
   380	
   381	    function isChainlinkStale() external view returns (bool) {
   382	        return _isChainlinkStale();
   383	    }

   385	    /// @notice Returns the timestamp after which the cached price is considered stale (0 if never set).
   386	    function priceValidUntil() external view returns (uint48) {
   387	        if (cachedPrice.updatedAt == 0) return 0;
   388	        return uint48(cachedPrice.updatedAt + priceStalenessThreshold);
   389	    }
   390	
   391	    function _checkEmergencyPrice(int256 newPrice) private view {
   392	        if (newPrice <= 0) revert OracleError();
   393	        if (!_isChainlinkStale()) revert ChainlinkNotStale();
   394	        if (emergencyActivatedAt != 0 && block.timestamp > emergencyActivatedAt + EMERGENCY_EXPIRY) {
   395	            revert EmergencyExpired();
   396	        }
   397	
   398	        int256 ref = cachedPrice.price;
   399	        if (ref <= 0) revert OracleError();
   400	
   401	        int256 denominator = int256(uint256(BPS_DENOMINATOR));
   402	        int256 lower = (ref
   403	                * int256(int256(uint256(BPS_DENOMINATOR - EMERGENCY_PRICE_DEVIATION_BPS)))
   404	                + denominator
   405	                - 1) / denominator;
   406	        int256 upper = (ref * int256(int256(uint256(BPS_DENOMINATOR + EMERGENCY_PRICE_DEVIATION_BPS)))) / denominator;
   407	        if (newPrice < lower || newPrice > upper) revert EmergencyPriceOutOfRange();
   408	    }
   409	
   410	    /// @notice Queue an emergency price update. Only honored when Chainlink is stale and the new
   411	    ///         price stays within ±20% of the last cached price; executable after EMERGENCY_TIMELOCK.
   412	    function emergencySetPrice(int256 newPrice) external onlyOwner {
   413	        _checkEmergencyPrice(newPrice);
   414	
   415	        emergencyPendingPrice = newPrice;
   416	        emergencyQueuedAt = block.timestamp;
   417	        emit EmergencyPriceQueued(newPrice, block.timestamp + EMERGENCY_TIMELOCK);
   418	    }
   419	
   420	    /// @notice Cancel a queued emergency price.
   421	    function cancelEmergencyPrice() external onlyOwner {
   422	        if (emergencyQueuedAt == 0) return; // idempotent
   423	        int256 cancelled = emergencyPendingPrice;
   424	        emergencyQueuedAt = 0;
   425	        emergencyPendingPrice = 0;
   426	        emit EmergencyPriceCancelled(cancelled);
   427	    }
   428	
   429	    /// @notice Apply a previously queued emergency price. Permissionless after the timelock, but
   430	    ///         the stale-oracle, expiry and deviation gates are re-checked against execution-time state.
   431	    function executeEmergencyPrice() external {
   432	        if (emergencyQueuedAt == 0) revert NoEmergencyPending();
   433	        if (block.timestamp < emergencyQueuedAt + EMERGENCY_TIMELOCK) {
   434	            revert EmergencyTimelockNotElapsed();
   435	        }
   436	
   437	        int256 newPrice = emergencyPendingPrice;
   438	        _checkEmergencyPrice(newPrice);
   439	        cachedPrice.price = newPrice;
   440	        cachedPrice.updatedAt = block.timestamp;
   441	        cachedPrice.roundId = 0;
   442	        cachedPrice.decimals = 8;
   443	
   444	        if (priceMode != 1) {
   445	            emit PriceModeChanged(priceMode, 1, msg.sender);
   446	            priceMode = 1;
   447	            emergencyActivatedAt = block.timestamp;
   448	        }
   449	
   450	        emergencyQueuedAt = 0;
   451	        emergencyPendingPrice = 0;
   452	
   453	        emit EmergencyPriceExecuted(newPrice);
   454	        emit PriceUpdated(newPrice, block.timestamp, msg.sender);
   455	    }
   456	
   457	    /**
   458	     * @notice Update price via DVT/BLS consensus or the owner (Safe) break-glass path.
   459	     * @dev The BLS aggregator is capped per update to ±20% of the cached price. The owner is
   460	     *      uncapped within [MIN_ETH_USD_PRICE, MAX_ETH_USD_PRICE]. Both callers remain subject to
   461	     *      two-hour recency, future-timestamp grace, strictly increasing updatedAt, and the
   462	     *      Chainlink ±20% check when Chainlink is fresh.
   463	     * @param chainlinkRecovered 0 = Chainlink still unavailable; 1 = recovered (clears priceMode).
   464	     */
   465	    function updatePriceDVT(int256 price, uint256 updatedAt, bytes calldata proof, uint8 chainlinkRecovered) external {
   466	        proof; // verified by BLSAggregator before it calls this function
   467	        // 1. Verify caller authority (owner path = emergency break-glass; Chainlink ±20% guard below)
   468	        if (msg.sender != BLS_AGGREGATOR && msg.sender != owner()) revert Unauthorized();
   469	
   470	        // V3.6 FIX: Prevent Replay & Staleness
   471	        if (updatedAt <= cachedPrice.updatedAt) revert OracleError(); // Must be strictly increasing
   472	        if (updatedAt < block.timestamp - 2 hours) revert OracleError(); // Must be recent
   473	        // P0-16: reject future timestamps (15 s keeper clock-skew grace).
   474	        if (updatedAt > block.timestamp + TIMESTAMP_GRACE_SECONDS) revert OracleError();
   475	
   476	        // 3. Validate absolute bounds and the per-update BLS movement cap.
   477	        if (price < MIN_ETH_USD_PRICE || price > MAX_ETH_USD_PRICE) revert OracleError();
   478	        if (msg.sender == BLS_AGGREGATOR && msg.sender != owner()) {
   479	            int256 referencePrice = cachedPrice.price;
   480	            if (referencePrice > 0) {
   481	                int256 delta = price > referencePrice ? price - referencePrice : referencePrice - price;
   482	                if (delta * int256(BPS_DENOMINATOR) > referencePrice * int256(EMERGENCY_PRICE_DEVIATION_BPS)) {
   483	                    revert OracleError();
   484	                }
   485	            }
   486	        }
   487	
   488	        // 4. Deviation from Chainlink (±20%) when Chainlink is recent
   489	        try ETH_USD_PRICE_FEED.latestRoundData() returns (
   490	            uint80, int256 chainlinkPrice, uint256, uint256 chainlinkUpdatedAt, uint80
   491	        ) {
   492	            // P1-42: guard chainlinkPrice <= 0 to prevent div-by-zero
   493	            if (chainlinkPrice > 0 && block.timestamp - chainlinkUpdatedAt < 2 hours) {
   494	                int256 delta = price > chainlinkPrice ? price - chainlinkPrice : chainlinkPrice - price;
   495	                if (delta * int256(BPS_DENOMINATOR) > chainlinkPrice * int256(EMERGENCY_PRICE_DEVIATION_BPS)) {
   496	                    revert OracleError();
   497	                }
   498	            }
   499	        } catch {
   500	            // Chainlink down: DVT price accepted without deviation check
   501	        }
   502	
   503	        // 5. Update cache
   504	        cachedPrice = PriceCache({
   505	            price: price,
   506	            updatedAt: updatedAt,
   507	            roundId: 0, // DVT doesn't have Chainlink RoundID
   508	            decimals: 8 // DVT normalizes to 8 decimals
   509	        });
   510	
   511	        if (chainlinkRecovered == 1 && priceMode != 0) {
   512	            emit PriceModeChanged(priceMode, 0, msg.sender);
   513	            priceMode = 0;
   514	            emergencyActivatedAt = 0;
   515	        }
   516	
   517	        emit PriceUpdated(price, updatedAt, msg.sender);
   518	    }

    53	/**
    54	 * @title SuperPaymasterLens
    55	 * @notice Off-chain diagnostic mirror of `SuperPaymaster.validatePaymasterUserOp` (5.5.1), moved
    56	 *         out of SP for EIP-170 (spec F1 / §5). Distinguishes the rejection paths that validation
    57	 *         reports as an opaque SIG_FAILURE.
    58	 * @dev    Stateless, non-upgradeable. It copies SP's internal constants, so it is bound to ONE SP
    59	 *         version: on any other version it answers (false, VERSION_MISMATCH) instead of guessing.
    60	 *         The user-side decision is NOT re-implemented here — it calls the token's `previewLock` /
    61	 *         `previewCredit`, which share their decision code with `tryLockForGas` / `tryReserveCredit`.
    62	 *         Kept in lock-step with validation by the D-layer consistency test.

   102	    /// @dev D5b: `paused()` is the public getter of SuperPaymasterStorage, answered by the core itself
   103	    ///      (only `gasParams()` is reached through the fallback, D5b-design §2.3).
   104	    ///      A pre-D5b 5.5.0 core has neither the selector nor a fallback → the staticcall fails and the
   105	    ///      lens reports "not paused", which is exactly what that implementation's validation does.
   106	    function _globallyPaused(address sp) private view returns (bool) {
   107	        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = sp.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSignature("paused()"));
   108	        return ok && ret.length >= 32 && abi.decode(ret, (bool));
   109	    }

   116	    /// @dev Mirror the core's fail-closed token probing: a revert, short return or return bomb is a
   117	    ///      rejection, not a Lens revert. Only the first word is needed, and at most 32 B is copied.
   118	    function _staticWord(address target, bytes memory data, uint256 minLen)
   119	        private
   120	        view
   121	        returns (bool success, uint256 word)
   122	    {
   123	        assembly ("memory-safe") {
   124	            success := staticcall(gas(), target, add(data, 32), mload(data), 0, 32)
   125	            if lt(returndatasize(), minLen) { success := 0 }
   126	            word := mload(0)
   127	        }
   128	    }

   130	    /// @notice Would `sp.validatePaymasterUserOp(userOp, hash, maxCost)` sponsor this op, and if
   131	    ///         not, why. Hard failures take precedence over the soft rate limit.
   132	    function dryRunValidation(address sp, PackedUserOperation calldata userOp, uint256 maxCost)
   133	        external
   134	        view
   135	        returns (bool ok, bytes32 reasonCode)
   136	    {
   137	        ISPLensView s = ISPLensView(sp);
   138	        if (keccak256(bytes(s.version())) != EXPECTED_SP_VERSION) return (false, DRYRUN_VERSION_MISMATCH);
   139	        if (_globallyPaused(sp)) return (false, DRYRUN_SPONSORSHIP_PAUSED);
   140	
   141	        bytes calldata pmd = userOp.paymasterAndData;
   142	        address operator =
   143	            pmd.length < 72 ? address(0) : address(bytes20(pmd[PAYMASTER_DATA_OFFSET:PAYMASTER_DATA_OFFSET + 20]));
   144	        (uint128 opBalance, bool isConfigured, bool isPaused, address xToken,, uint48 minTxInterval,,,) =
   145	            s.operators(operator);
   146	        if (!isConfigured) return (false, DRYRUN_OPERATOR_NOT_CONFIGURED);
   147	        if (isPaused) return (false, DRYRUN_OPERATOR_PAUSED);
   148	        if (!s.isEligibleForSponsorship(userOp.sender)) return (false, DRYRUN_USER_NOT_ELIGIBLE);
   149	        if (
   150	            pmd.length >= POSTOP_GAS_OFFSET + 16
   151	                && uint128(bytes16(pmd[POSTOP_GAS_OFFSET:POSTOP_GAS_OFFSET + 16])) < _minPostOpGas(s)
   152	        ) {
   153	            return (false, DRYRUN_POSTOP_GAS_TOO_LOW);
   154	        }
   155	        (uint48 lastTime, bool blocked) = s.userOpState(operator, userOp.sender);
   156	        if (blocked) return (false, DRYRUN_USER_BLOCKED);
   157	        bool rateLimited =
   158	            minTxInterval > 0 && lastTime != 0 && block.timestamp < uint256(lastTime) + uint256(minTxInterval);
   159	
   160	        if (pmd.length < TOKEN_OFFSET + 20) return (false, DRYRUN_TOKEN_MISMATCH);
   161	        if (address(bytes20(pmd[TOKEN_OFFSET:TOKEN_OFFSET + 20])) != xToken) return (false, DRYRUN_TOKEN_MISMATCH);
   162	        uint8 flags = pmd.length > FLAGS_OFFSET ? uint8(pmd[FLAGS_OFFSET]) : 0;
   163	        if (flags & (FLAG_SP_RENEW | FLAG_ACCOUNT_RENEW) == (FLAG_SP_RENEW | FLAG_ACCOUNT_RENEW)) {
   164	            return (false, DRYRUN_TOKEN_MISMATCH);
   165	        }
   166	        (bool tokenOk, uint256 rate) = _staticWord(xToken, abi.encodeCall(IxPNTsTokenV2.exchangeRate, ()), 32);
   167	        if (!tokenOk || rate > abi.decode(pmd[RATE_OFFSET:RATE_OFFSET + 32], (uint256))) {
   168	            return (false, DRYRUN_RATE_COMMITMENT_VIOLATED);
   169	        }
   170	
   171	        (int256 price, uint256 updatedAt,, uint8 decimals) = s.cachedPrice();
   172	        if (updatedAt == 0 || price <= 0 || block.timestamp > updatedAt + s.priceStalenessThreshold()) {
   173	            return (false, DRYRUN_STALE_PRICE);
   174	        }
   175	        uint256 a0 = Math.mulDiv(
   176	            maxCost * uint256(price), 1e18, (10 ** uint256(decimals)) * s.aPNTsPriceUSD(), Math.Rounding.Ceil
   177	        );
   178	        a0 = Math.mulDiv(
   179	            a0, BPS_DENOMINATOR + s.protocolFeeBPS() + VALIDATION_BUFFER_BPS, BPS_DENOMINATOR, Math.Rounding.Ceil
   180	        );
   181	        if (a0 > type(uint96).max) return (false, DRYRUN_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_UINT96);
   182	        if (uint256(opBalance) < a0) return (false, DRYRUN_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE);
   183	
   184	        bytes32 opHash = s.entryPoint().getUserOpHash(userOp);
   185	        uint256 lr;
   186	        (tokenOk, lr) = _staticWord(
   187	            xToken,
   188	            abi.encodeCall(IxPNTsTokenV2.previewLock, (sp, userOp.sender, opHash, a0, flags & FLAG_SP_RENEW != 0)),
   189	            64
   190	        );
   191	        if (!tokenOk || lr > uint256(IxPNTsTokenV2.LockResult.DISABLED)) {
   192	            return (false, DRYRUN_LOCK_REJECTED);
   193	        }
   194	        if (lr != uint256(IxPNTsTokenV2.LockResult.OK)) {
   195	            if (lr != uint256(IxPNTsTokenV2.LockResult.INSUFFICIENT)) {
   196	                return (false, DRYRUN_LOCK_REJECTED | bytes32(lr));
   197	            }
   198	            uint256 cr;
   199	            (tokenOk, cr) =
   200	                _staticWord(xToken, abi.encodeCall(IxPNTsTokenV2.previewCredit, (sp, userOp.sender, opHash, a0)), 32);
   201	            if (!tokenOk || cr > uint256(IxPNTsTokenV2.CreditResult.DISABLED)) {
   202	                return (false, DRYRUN_CREDIT_REJECTED);
   203	            }
   204	            if (cr != uint256(IxPNTsTokenV2.CreditResult.OK)) {
   205	                return (false, DRYRUN_CREDIT_REJECTED | bytes32(cr));
   206	            }
   207	        }
   208	
   209	        if (rateLimited) return (false, DRYRUN_RATE_LIMITED);
   210	        return (true, DRYRUN_OK);
   211	    }
   212	}

    11	/**
    12	 * @title BasePaymasterUpgradeable
    13	 * @notice UUPS-compatible base paymaster for ERC-4337 v0.7
    14	 * @dev Keeps entryPoint as immutable (stored in implementation bytecode).
    15	 *      On upgrade, deploy new implementation with same entryPoint address.
    16	 *      D5b GOV-2: ownership is two-step (Ownable2StepNamespaced: pending owner in an ERC-7201 slot,
    17	 *      renounce disabled); the sequential layout is still exactly OZ Ownable's (`_owner` at slot 0).
    18	 */
    19	abstract contract BasePaymasterUpgradeable is IPaymaster, Ownable2StepNamespaced, Initializable, UUPSUpgradeable {
    20	    /// @notice The EntryPoint contract (immutable for gas savings on hot path)
    21	    IEntryPoint public immutable entryPoint;
    22	
    23	    /// @custom:oz-upgrades-unsafe-allow constructor
    24	    constructor(IEntryPoint _entryPoint) Ownable(msg.sender) {
    25	        if (address(_entryPoint) == address(0)) {
    26	            revert("Invalid EntryPoint");
    27	        }
    28	        entryPoint = _entryPoint;
    29	        _disableInitializers();
    30	    }
    31	
    32	    /**
    33	     * @notice Initialize the upgradeable paymaster
    34	     * @param _owner The owner address
    35	     */
    36	    function __BasePaymaster_init(address _owner) internal onlyInitializing {
    37	        _transferOwnership(_owner);
    38	    }
    39	
    40	    // ====================================
    41	    // UUPS Authorization
    42	    // ====================================
    43	
    44	    /// @dev GOV-2: no implementation change while a two-step nomination is pending (see Ownable2StepNamespaced).
    45	    function _authorizeUpgrade(address) internal override onlyOwner { _requireNoPendingOwner(); }
    46	
    47	    // ====================================
    48	    // EntryPoint Stake Management
    49	    // ====================================
    50	
    51	    function deposit() external payable onlyOwner {
    52	        entryPoint.depositTo{value: msg.value}(address(this));
    53	    }
    54	
    55	    function withdrawTo(address payable to, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
    56	        entryPoint.withdrawTo(to, amount);
    57	    }
    58	
    59	    function addStake(uint32 unstakeDelaySec) external payable onlyOwner {
    60	        entryPoint.addStake{value: msg.value}(unstakeDelaySec);
    61	    }
    62	
    63	    function unlockStake() external onlyOwner {
    64	        entryPoint.unlockStake();
    65	    }
    66	
    67	    function withdrawStake(address payable to) external onlyOwner {
    68	        entryPoint.withdrawStake(to);
    69	    }
    70	
    71	    function getDeposit() external view returns (uint256) {
    72	        return entryPoint.balanceOf(address(this));
    73	    }
    74	
    75	    // ====================================
    76	    // IPaymaster (abstract)
    77	    // ====================================
    78	
    79	    function validatePaymasterUserOp(
    80	        PackedUserOperation calldata userOp,
    81	        bytes32 userOpHash,
    82	        uint256 maxCost
    83	    ) external virtual returns (bytes memory context, uint256 validationData);

    85	    function postOp(

    87	        bytes calldata context,
    88	        uint256 actualGasCost,
    89	        uint256 actualUserOpFeePerGas
    90	    ) external virtual;
    91	
    92	    modifier onlyEntryPoint() {
    93	        require(msg.sender == address(entryPoint), "BasePaymaster: caller is not EntryPoint");
    94	        _;
    95	    }
    96	}

   565	    function _verifyBLS(bytes calldata proof, bytes32 messageHash) internal {
   566	        (uint256 signerMask, bytes memory sigG2Bytes) = abi.decode(proof, (uint256, bytes));
   567	        address agg = blsAggregator;
   568	        uint256 threshold = IBLSAggregator(agg).defaultThreshold();
   569	        uint256 _m = signerMask; uint256 _bits; while (_m != 0) { _m &= (_m - 1); _bits++; }

   574	    function batchUpdateGlobalReputation(
   575	        uint256 proposalId,
   576	        address[] calldata users,
   577	        uint256[] calldata newScores,
   578	        uint256 epoch,
   579	        bytes calldata proof
   580	    ) external nonReentrant {
   581	        if (!isReputationSource[msg.sender]) revert UnauthorizedSource();
   582	        if (users.length != newScores.length) revert LenMismatch();
   583	        if (users.length > 200) revert BatchTooLarge();
   584	        if (proof.length == 0) revert BLSProofRequired();
   585	        if (blsAggregator == address(0)) revert BLSNotConfigured();
   586	        if (proposalId == 0) revert InvalidProposalId();
   587	        // L-C: epoch=0 would skip every user (epoch <= lastReputationEpoch, default 0)
   588	        // yet still burn the proposalId below — a permanently wasted, un-retryable proposal.
   589	        if (epoch == 0) revert InvalidParam();
   590	        // CC-48 round-9 MEDIUM-HIGH-B3: a freshly upgraded proxy reads zero in the
   591	        // population slots while real, already-promoted users exist on-chain. Deriving
   592	        // exposure from that empty population would under-count the live stock by exactly
   593	        // the pre-upgrade issuance, so the reputation path stays SHUT until governance has
   594	        // seeded the population and declared it complete. Fresh deployments are seeded in
   595	        // `initialize`, where the population provably IS empty.
   596	        if (creditPopulationSeededAt == 0) revert CreditPopulationNotSeeded();
   597	        if (executedProposals[proposalId]) revert ProposalAlreadyExecuted();

   599	        executedProposals[proposalId] = true;

   601	
   602	        uint256 aggregateUplift;
   603	        uint256 aggregateRelease;
   604	        uint256 backfill;
   605	        uint256 marker = creditPopulationEpoch + 1;
   606	        uint256 floorLimit = creditTierConfig[1];
   607	        for (uint256 i = 0; i < users.length; ) {
   608	            address user = users[i];
   609	            if (epoch <= lastReputationEpoch[user]) {
   610	                unchecked { ++i; }
   611	                continue;
   612	            }
   613	            uint256 _old = globalReputation[user]; uint256 _new = newScores[i];
   614	            uint256 clamped = (_new > _old)
   615	                ? ((_new - _old > 100) ? _old + 100 : _new)
   616	                : ((_old > _new && _old - _new > 100) ? _old - 100 : _new);
   617	            uint256 oldLimit = creditTierConfig[_levelForReputation(_old)];
   618	            uint256 newLimit = creditTierConfig[_levelForReputation(clamped)];
   619	            if (newLimit > oldLimit) aggregateUplift += newLimit - oldLimit;
   620	            else if (oldLimit > newLimit) aggregateRelease += oldLimit - newLimit;
   621	            // CC-48 round-9 MEDIUM-HIGH-B3: self-healing. A promoted user the migration
   622	            // seed missed carries stock this ledger has never seen, so the FIRST proposal
   623	            // that touches them books their whole standing above-floor limit. Counted as
   624	            // `backfill` rather than as uplift so it cannot spuriously trip the
   625	            // per-proposal cap, which measures what THIS proposal issued.
   626	            if (creditPopulationEpochOf[user] != marker) {
   627	                creditPopulationEpochOf[user] = marker;
   628	                creditPopulationTotal += 1;
   629	                if (oldLimit > floorLimit) backfill += oldLimit - floorLimit;
   630	            }
   631	            globalReputation[user] = clamped;
   632	            lastReputationEpoch[user] = epoch;
   633	            emit GlobalReputationUpdated(user, clamped, epoch);

   636	        uint256 cap = maxAggregateCreditUpliftPerProposal;
   637	        if (aggregateUplift > cap) revert AggregateCreditUpliftExceeded(aggregateUplift, cap);

   640	        // a colluding quorum can emit N proposals in one block and mint N * cap. The real
   641	        // bound is this running stock of outstanding credit exposure, which every proposal
   642	        // is measured against no matter how the work is sliced.
   643	        //
   644	        // The stock is exact rather than approximate because the ONLY other things that can
   645	        // move a user's credit limit -- `setCreditTier` and `setLevelThresholds` -- do not
   646	        // edit this number, they INVALIDATE it (round-9 HIGH-B1): they shut this path until
   647	        // governance re-counts. So between two re-counts the tier schedule is frozen and
   648	        // these deltas are the whole of the movement.
   649	        //
   650	        // Saturating subtraction keeps the running total from ever underflowing. Round-8

   652	        // REVERTING, which would leave the downgrade unapplied and the user holding the
   653	        // HIGHER limit -- strictly worse for the bound. It can only be more conservative.
   654	        uint256 total = totalCreditExposure + aggregateUplift + backfill;

   656	        uint256 totalCap = maxTotalCreditExposure;
   657	        if (total > totalCap) revert TotalCreditExposureExceeded(total, totalCap);

    26	 * @title SuperPaymasterV55GasTest — spec §9 "G gas" / §11 R10-M3: the C_WRAP bound, trace-derived
    27	 *        on the CANONICAL EntryPoint v0.7 runtime bytecode (fetched from chain, codehash
    28	 *        0x8db5ff69…fc58 — identical on Sepolia, OP Sepolia and OP mainnet).
    29	 * @dev    EntryPoint v0.7 `_postExecution` charges the paymaster
    30	 *           F = P + seg + penalty,   seg = wrap + postOpFrame,
    31	 *         where P is the gas already counted when postOp is called (passed as actualGasCost),
    32	 *         postOpFrame <= postOpGasLimit, penalty = 10% of unused (callGasLimit + postOpGasLimit).
    33	 *         SP charges for P plus bufWei = (postOpGasLimit + ceil((callGas + postOpGas)·10/100)
    34	 *         + C_WRAP) × fee, so C_WRAP must bound `wrap` — EntryPoint's own overhead around the
    35	 *         postOp call (ABI-encoding the context, the CALL, return handling, bookkeeping).
    36	 *         Part 1 measures wrap with a probe paymaster (upper bound: F − P − limit + BURN_FLOOR,
    37	 *         penalty only inflates it). Part 2 checks the operational property on SP itself:
    38	 *         the user's charge covers the final cost EntryPoint takes from SP's deposit.
    39	 */

   250	        op = _baseOp(user, nonce, callGas, callData);

   257	    /// @dev The charge the operator would need to be made whole for `finalCostWei` at the
   258	    ///      validation snapshot (same rounding as SP's postOp).
   259	    function _fullCostCharge(uint256 finalCostWei) internal view returns (uint256) {
   260	        (int256 price, , , uint8 dec) = sp.cachedPrice();
   261	        uint256 a = Math.mulDiv(finalCostWei * uint256(price), 1e18, (10 ** uint256(dec)) * sp.aPNTsPriceUSD(), Math.Rounding.Ceil);
   262	        return Math.mulDiv(a, 10_000 + sp.protocolFeeBPS(), 10_000, Math.Rounding.Ceil);
   263	    }

   265	    function _spCase(uint128 callGas, bytes memory callData, uint128 postOpGas) internal {
   266	        address user = _deploySP();
   267	        PackedUserOperation memory op = _spOp(user, 0, callGas, callData, postOpGas);
   268	        // a0 (the clamp) from the same validation, discarded afterwards

   271	        vm.prank(EP);
   272	        (bytes memory ctx, ) = sp.validatePaymasterUserOp(op, h, 1e16);
   273	        uint256 a0 = abi.decode(ctx, (SuperPaymaster.OpCtx)).a0;
   274	        vm.revertTo(snap);
   275	
   276	        uint256 revBefore = sp.protocolRevenue();

   278	        ops[0] = op;
   279	        (, uint256[] memory costs) = _run(ops);
   280	        uint256 charge = sp.protocolRevenue() - revBefore;
   281	        uint256 need = _fullCostCharge(costs[0]);
   282	        console.log("final cost wei", costs[0]);
   283	        console.log("charge / need (aPNTs wei)", charge, need);
   284	        assertGt(charge, 0, "settled");
   285	        assertLt(charge, a0, "precondition: not clamped at a0 (clamp cannot mask an undercharge)");
   286	        assertGe(charge, need, "user charge covers EntryPoint's final cost to SP (C_WRAP + buffer sufficient)");
   287	    }

Audited commit `053117cc8ca31eb69ae1f62755a1d7790e71190f` read-only. No files were modified, no network/RPC was used, and no build was necessary. The checked-out source reports `SuperPaymaster-5.5.2`; reachability below uses the supplied 5.5.0 deployment assumptions.

## New / newly confirmed findings

### M-02 — Medium — Exited or under-staked operators remain authorized until an external watcher pauses them

- **Location:** [SuperPaymaster.sol:272](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/paymasters/superpaymaster/v3/SuperPaymaster.sol:272), [SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol:117](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/paymasters/superpaymaster/v3/SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol:117), [Registry.sol:373](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/core/Registry.sol:373)
- **Precondition and sequence:**
  1. A valid COMMUNITY/PAYMASTER_SUPER operator calls `configureOperator`, setting `isConfigured=true`.
  2. After its role lock expires, it calls `Registry.exitRole(ROLE_PAYMASTER_SUPER)`.
  3. Registry removes the role and releases the stake, but does not clear or pause the SuperPaymaster configuration.
  4. Before a third party calls `pauseUnderstakedOperator`, UserOperations selecting that operator reach validation.
  5. Validation checks only `isConfigured` and `isPaused`; it does not verify the current role or effective stake, so sponsorship continues.
- **Impact:** The operator can continue using a privileged, ostensibly stake-backed service after recovering its admission stake. This creates an unbounded watcher race and breaks the role/stake accountability invariant. An already submitted bundle can also land before the permissionless pause.
- **5.5.0 reachability:** **Yes.** It is especially straightforward because an operator normally retains its COMMUNITY role, so exiting PAYMASTER_SUPER does not trigger final-role cleanup. The supplied “no slashing enabled” configuration removes an additional accountability mechanism.
- **Minimal fix:** Add a Registry-only revocation hook that atomically sets `isPaused=true` or `isConfigured=false` when PAYMASTER_SUPER is removed, before stake release. Avoid a live Registry call in validation; a pushed local authorization bit preserves the existing ERC-7562 validation surface.
- **Classification note:** This confirms the previously unverified note in `docs/security/2026-05-31-pk-audit-findings.md`; it was not listed among the accepted rc8 residuals.

### L-01 — Low — Chainlink cache accepts future-dated rounds

- **Location:** [SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol:521](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/paymasters/superpaymaster/v3/SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol:521), particularly lines 526–529.
- **Precondition and sequence:**
  1. The configured feed returns an in-range price, valid round relation, and `updatedAt > block.timestamp`.
  2. Anyone calls `updatePrice()`.
  3. The stale check accepts the future timestamp and caches it.
  4. Validation computes `validUntil = updatedAt + priceStalenessThreshold`, extending the price’s apparent lifetime into the future.
- **Impact:** A faulty or compromised feed report can keep a stale or incorrect price usable beyond the intended staleness window, mispricing reservations and final charges. It can also cause underflow in the fresh-Chainlink comparison inside `updatePriceDVT`, obstructing that fallback route.
- **5.5.0 reachability:** **Conditional, not under normal Chainlink behavior.** The configured feed must return a future timestamp.
- **Minimal fix:** Reject `updatedAt == 0` and `updatedAt > block.timestamp + TIMESTAMP_GRACE_SECONDS` before caching. Apply the same guarded comparison before subtracting `chainlinkUpdatedAt` in `updatePriceDVT`.

### I-01 — Info — Oracle decimal compatibility is assumed rather than enforced

- **Location:** [SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol:529](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/paymasters/superpaymaster/v3/SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol:529)
- **Precondition and sequence:** Deploy an implementation with a feed whose `decimals()` is not eight; call `updatePrice`; the cache nevertheless records `decimals: 8`; validation and settlement then scale the price as eight-decimal data.
- **Impact:** Mispricing by a power-of-ten factor on an incorrectly configured network or feed replacement.
- **5.5.0 reachability:** **No for the intended eight-decimal ETH/USD feed; configuration hazard only.**
- **Minimal fix:** Require `ETH_USD_PRICE_FEED.decimals() == 8` at construction/deployment, or cache the actual decimals and explicitly bound them.

## Confirmations of known/disclosed items

### K-01 — Low — Same-bundle rate-limit bypass remains

- **Location:** [SuperPaymaster.sol:315](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/paymasters/superpaymaster/v3/SuperPaymaster.sol:315), [SuperPaymaster.sol:454](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/paymasters/superpaymaster/v3/SuperPaymaster.sol:454)
- **Precondition and sequence:** A bundler includes two operations for the same `(operator, sender)` in one bundle. Both validations read the old `lastTimestamp`; neither updates it. Both pass, then their respective `postOp` calls write the timestamp.
- **Impact:** Bypasses `minTxInterval` within one bundle. Each operation still independently reserves and pays, limiting the effect.
- **5.5.0 reachability:** **Yes.**
- **Minimal fix:** The documented sender-associated transient same-bundle marker, after validation against the supported production bundler tracers.

### K-02 — Info — ERC-7562 compliance remains conditional on the configured identity registry

- **Location:** [SuperPaymaster.sol:524](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/paymasters/superpaymaster/v3/SuperPaymaster.sol:524)
- **Precondition and sequence:** Configure a nonzero identity registry that executes TIMESTAMP/NUMBER or reads forbidden storage; validate a sender without cached SBT eligibility; validation calls that registry.
- **Impact:** Bundlers reject affected UserOperations even though `try/catch` converts Solidity reverts to `false`; opcode and storage-rule violations cannot be caught.
- **5.5.0 reachability:** **The call path is reachable** because the checked-in Sepolia configuration names a nonzero registry. An actual violation depends on that exact implementation; it was not inspected through network/RPC.
- **Minimal fix:** Keep the path disabled until the exact runtime hash and complete opcode/storage trace are pinned, as already required by the disclosure document.

### K-03 — Low — Stale-Chainlink BLS price updates permit cumulative drift

- **Location:** [SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol:465](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/paymasters/superpaymaster/v3/SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol:465)
- **Precondition and sequence:** Chainlink is stale; an authorized aggregator/quorum repeatedly invokes `updatePriceDVT` with strictly increasing timestamps and each price within ±20% of the preceding cached price.
- **Impact:** Multiple accepted updates can compound toward the absolute price bounds, changing user charges and operator reservations substantially.
- **5.5.0 reachability:** **Yes for the authorized BLS price path.** The supplied absence of slasher authority does not disable price updates.
- **Minimal fix:** Bind DVT prices to a non-compounding anchor or cumulative time-window bound, and route the selector through a dedicated proof-checked path rather than generic execution.

The native balance and credit validation paths contain no direct TIMESTAMP/NUMBER use; timestamp writes remain in `postOp`. Reservation, settlement, stale release, price/fee snapshots, and xPNTs lock/credit accounting otherwise remained internally conserved in the reviewed flows.

Audited commit `053117cc8ca31eb69ae1f62755a1d7790e71190f` read-only. No files were modified, no network/RPC was used, and no build was necessary. The checked-out source reports `SuperPaymaster-5.5.2`; reachability below uses the supplied 5.5.0 deployment assumptions.

## New / newly confirmed findings

### M-02 — Medium — Exited or under-staked operators remain authorized until an external watcher pauses them

- **Location:** [SuperPaymaster.sol:272](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/paymasters/superpaymaster/v3/SuperPaymaster.sol:272), [SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol:117](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/paymasters/superpaymaster/v3/SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol:117), [Registry.sol:373](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/core/Registry.sol:373)
- **Precondition and sequence:**
  1. A valid COMMUNITY/PAYMASTER_SUPER operator calls `configureOperator`, setting `isConfigured=true`.
  2. After its role lock expires, it calls `Registry.exitRole(ROLE_PAYMASTER_SUPER)`.
  3. Registry removes the role and releases the stake, but does not clear or pause the SuperPaymaster configuration.
  4. Before a third party calls `pauseUnderstakedOperator`, UserOperations selecting that operator reach validation.
  5. Validation checks only `isConfigured` and `isPaused`; it does not verify the current role or effective stake, so sponsorship continues.
- **Impact:** The operator can continue using a privileged, ostensibly stake-backed service after recovering its admission stake. This creates an unbounded watcher race and breaks the role/stake accountability invariant. An already submitted bundle can also land before the permissionless pause.
- **5.5.0 reachability:** **Yes.** It is especially straightforward because an operator normally retains its COMMUNITY role, so exiting PAYMASTER_SUPER does not trigger final-role cleanup. The supplied “no slashing enabled” configuration removes an additional accountability mechanism.
- **Minimal fix:** Add a Registry-only revocation hook that atomically sets `isPaused=true` or `isConfigured=false` when PAYMASTER_SUPER is removed, before stake release. Avoid a live Registry call in validation; a pushed local authorization bit preserves the existing ERC-7562 validation surface.
- **Classification note:** This confirms the previously unverified note in `docs/security/2026-05-31-pk-audit-findings.md`; it was not listed among the accepted rc8 residuals.

### L-01 — Low — Chainlink cache accepts future-dated rounds

- **Location:** [SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol:521](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/paymasters/superpaymaster/v3/SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol:521), particularly lines 526–529.
- **Precondition and sequence:**
  1. The configured feed returns an in-range price, valid round relation, and `updatedAt > block.timestamp`.
  2. Anyone calls `updatePrice()`.
  3. The stale check accepts the future timestamp and caches it.
  4. Validation computes `validUntil = updatedAt + priceStalenessThreshold`, extending the price’s apparent lifetime into the future.
- **Impact:** A faulty or compromised feed report can keep a stale or incorrect price usable beyond the intended staleness window, mispricing reservations and final charges. It can also cause underflow in the fresh-Chainlink comparison inside `updatePriceDVT`, obstructing that fallback route.
- **5.5.0 reachability:** **Conditional, not under normal Chainlink behavior.** The configured feed must return a future timestamp.
- **Minimal fix:** Reject `updatedAt == 0` and `updatedAt > block.timestamp + TIMESTAMP_GRACE_SECONDS` before caching. Apply the same guarded comparison before subtracting `chainlinkUpdatedAt` in `updatePriceDVT`.

### I-01 — Info — Oracle decimal compatibility is assumed rather than enforced

- **Location:** [SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol:529](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/paymasters/superpaymaster/v3/SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol:529)
- **Precondition and sequence:** Deploy an implementation with a feed whose `decimals()` is not eight; call `updatePrice`; the cache nevertheless records `decimals: 8`; validation and settlement then scale the price as eight-decimal data.
- **Impact:** Mispricing by a power-of-ten factor on an incorrectly configured network or feed replacement.
- **5.5.0 reachability:** **No for the intended eight-decimal ETH/USD feed; configuration hazard only.**
- **Minimal fix:** Require `ETH_USD_PRICE_FEED.decimals() == 8` at construction/deployment, or cache the actual decimals and explicitly bound them.

## Confirmations of known/disclosed items

### K-01 — Low — Same-bundle rate-limit bypass remains

- **Location:** [SuperPaymaster.sol:315](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/paymasters/superpaymaster/v3/SuperPaymaster.sol:315), [SuperPaymaster.sol:454](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/paymasters/superpaymaster/v3/SuperPaymaster.sol:454)
- **Precondition and sequence:** A bundler includes two operations for the same `(operator, sender)` in one bundle. Both validations read the old `lastTimestamp`; neither updates it. Both pass, then their respective `postOp` calls write the timestamp.
- **Impact:** Bypasses `minTxInterval` within one bundle. Each operation still independently reserves and pays, limiting the effect.
- **5.5.0 reachability:** **Yes.**
- **Minimal fix:** The documented sender-associated transient same-bundle marker, after validation against the supported production bundler tracers.

### K-02 — Info — ERC-7562 compliance remains conditional on the configured identity registry

- **Location:** [SuperPaymaster.sol:524](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/paymasters/superpaymaster/v3/SuperPaymaster.sol:524)
- **Precondition and sequence:** Configure a nonzero identity registry that executes TIMESTAMP/NUMBER or reads forbidden storage; validate a sender without cached SBT eligibility; validation calls that registry.
- **Impact:** Bundlers reject affected UserOperations even though `try/catch` converts Solidity reverts to `false`; opcode and storage-rule violations cannot be caught.
- **5.5.0 reachability:** **The call path is reachable** because the checked-in Sepolia configuration names a nonzero registry. An actual violation depends on that exact implementation; it was not inspected through network/RPC.
- **Minimal fix:** Keep the path disabled until the exact runtime hash and complete opcode/storage trace are pinned, as already required by the disclosure document.

### K-03 — Low — Stale-Chainlink BLS price updates permit cumulative drift

- **Location:** [SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol:465](/Users/jason/Dev/aastar/sp-wt/rc8-bls/contracts/src/paymasters/superpaymaster/v3/SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol:465)
- **Precondition and sequence:** Chainlink is stale; an authorized aggregator/quorum repeatedly invokes `updatePriceDVT` with strictly increasing timestamps and each price within ±20% of the preceding cached price.
- **Impact:** Multiple accepted updates can compound toward the absolute price bounds, changing user charges and operator reservations substantially.
- **5.5.0 reachability:** **Yes for the authorized BLS price path.** The supplied absence of slasher authority does not disable price updates.
- **Minimal fix:** Bind DVT prices to a non-compounding anchor or cumulative time-window bound, and route the selector through a dedicated proof-checked path rather than generic execution.

The native balance and credit validation paths contain no direct TIMESTAMP/NUMBER use; timestamp writes remain in `postOp`. Reservation, settlement, stale release, price/fee snapshots, and xPNTs lock/credit accounting otherwise remained internally conserved in the reviewed flows.
